welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to PingMe!
welcome.desc:
PingMe is a multi-service social network with many exciting features.

Let's take a quick look at the main functions!

chat.title: 💬 Messages
chat.desc:
Chat 1-1 or in groups with friends.

Send messages, photos, files, and make video calls.

contacts.title: 👥 Contacts
contacts.desc:
Manage your friend list.

Search for, add new friends, and manage friend requests.

music.title: 🎵 Music
music.desc:
Listen to music online, create your own playlists.

Explore artists, albums, and charts.

reels.title: 🎬 Reels
reels.desc:
Watch and share exciting short videos.

Search for videos and manage your own.

ai.title: 🤖 Ping AI
ai.desc:
Your smart AI assistant is here to help.

Ask questions, get advice, or just chat with AI.

account.title: ⚙️ Account
account.desc:
Manage your profile, change password, and log out.

Click the avatar to open the account menu.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to Profile!
welcome.desc:
This is where you manage your account.

📸 Click the avatar to change your profile picture (JPG/PNG, up to 5MB).

infoNav.title: 📋 Personal Info
infoNav.desc: View and edit your personal information. Let's see the details!

infoEdit.title: ✏️ Edit Information
infoEdit.desc:
Here you can update:

• Name, Gender, Birthday, Address
• Email cannot be changed after registration

Click "Update Information" below to save.

passwordNav.title: 🔐 Change Password
passwordNav.desc: Change your password periodically for account security. Let's see the details!

passwordForm.title: 🔐 Change Password
passwordForm.desc:
Enter your current password, new password (at least 6 characters), and confirm.

💡 The system automatically checks password strength.

deviceNav.title: 📱 Device Management
deviceNav.desc: View and manage the devices currently logged into your account. Let's see the details!

deviceManage.title: 📱 Device Management
deviceManage.desc:
See all logged-in devices, check OS and browser.

🗑️ Click "Remove Session" to log out remotely if you suspect unusual access.

🟢 The current session is marked green and cannot be removed.
